thesis: From September 4 through September 8, VRTX fell 3.15%, NEM 0.78%, CRM 3.90%, and BAC 0.46%, versus SPY down 0.55%; the target-weight approximation fell 1.28% and lagged SPY by 0.73 point. That is another miss, but the named catalysts remain ahead: Salesforce Dreamforce runs September 15–17, BAC's CEO speaks September 14 immediately before the September 15–16 FOMC meeting, and VRTX's povetacicept PDUFA date is November 30. Hold the existing 60%-invested book, lower confidence, and refresh limits rather than chase screen leaders after large moves. NEM remains the least precisely dated sleeve: management expects third-quarter production broadly in line with Q2 and 51% of full-year production in H2, but no exact Q3 call date is posted. This is the project's paper-portfolio bridge, not an official plugin investment recommendation.
